title: ProShirt - Fit Check
visual_summary: Adjusting ProShirt smart garment straps for optimal sensor contact against skin.
narration_summary: Make sure your monitoring shirt fits correctly before sleep so your breathing and heart signals are captured clearly.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Signal quality indicator turns green confirming proper sensor fit.
